violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: prime rib (101f) and mashed potato (110f) have been stored in Vulcan hot holding cabinet for about 1.5 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: (1) prime rib will be discarded within 2.5 hours; (2) CFM reheated the mashed potato to 166f.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): Grand Marnier soufflé base and chocolate soufflé base.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: TPHC agreement established.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: Caesar salad dressing.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM revised the menu and indicated that the Caesar salad dressing contains undercooked ingredients.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: HACCP Plan Required for ROP
violations.observation: A HACCP Plan was not submitted prior to engaging in reduced oxygen packaging chicken and lobster shells
violations.corrective_action: - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the ROP chicken and ROP lobster shells.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: - OBSERVED: frozen tuna was thawing in an intact reduced oxygen packaging (ROP) package.
violations.corrective_action: - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM opened the package of ROP tuna.

violations.title: Polished/Artificial Nails
violations.observation: Employee with fingernail polish or artificial nails observed handling exposed food while not wearing gloves.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees using fake finger nails or finger nail polish shall always where gloves when handling food. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted the food employee to put on gloves.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label. THE DATE OF THE LAST SHELLSTOCK SOLD AFTER 10/23/2025 WERE NOT RECORDED.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: (1) MORNAY SAUCE (124F) WAS STORED ON STEAM TABLE FOR ABOUT 2 HOURS; (2) MASHED POTATO (124F) AND PRIME RIB (110-118F) WERE STORED IN VULCAN HOT BOX FOR ABBOUT 2 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. (1) CFM REHEATED THE MORNAY SAUCE TO 168F; (2) CFM WILL DISCARD TH MASHED POTATO AND PRIME RIB IN 2 HOURS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: TOMATO SAUCE (38F) WAS PORTIONED ON 11/12/2025. BY THE TIME OF INSPECTION, IT HAS BEEN STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: CRAB FRITTER (33-36F) WAS STORED IN DELFIELD 1-DOOR UP COOLER FOR 2 DAYS AND WERE NOT PROPERLY MARKED WITH PREPARATION DATE.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM CORRECTED.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: UTENSILS WERE STORED IN BAR HAND SINK WITH WATER RUNNING.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. UTENSILS WERE SENT TO WASH.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. A FOOD EMPLOYEE WAS WASHING UTENSILS AT HAND SINK AT PASTRY STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CFM EDUCATED THE FOOD EMPLOYEE.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the @LOCATION@ is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. HAND SINK AT COOK LINE WAS USED TO DRUMP ICE AND STORE UTENSILS.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CFM RELOCATED THE UTENSILS.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Shellstock has been removed from the tagged/labeled container without preserving source identification. THERE ARE NO TAGS FOR OYSTERS AND MUSSELS IN WORKING CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM. CFM WILL ADD TAGS TO WORKING CONTAINERS.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: PACKAGES OF UNSALTED BUTTER (70F) WERE STORED ON SPEED RACK AT PASTRY FOR ABOUT 5.5 HOURS
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM DISCARDED THE UNSALTED BUTTER.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: CAESAR DRESSING (38F) WAS PREPARED ON 5/25/2025. BY THE TIME OF INSPECTION, IT HAS BEEN STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER (BIG) FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: ALL REFRIGERATORS AT COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM PROVIDED TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES FOR ALL REFRIGERATORS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Ice used as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food is also for beverage ice or used as food. ICE USED AS A MEDIUM FOR COOLING FRUITS ALSO USED FOR BEVERAGE ICE.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. EHS EDUCATED THE FOOD EMPLOYEE. 801 CHOPHOUSE (Inspection Date: 06/03/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. (1) MILK CRATES WERE USED TO STORE FOOD ITEMS IN WALK-IN COOLER FOR BEERS. (2) DRINKS WERE STORED ON FLOOR IN DRY STORAGE AREAS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM WILL RELOCATE THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: TEA MIXERS WERE STORED IN A CONTAINER OF STAGNANT WATER AT 82F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM DISCARDED THE WATER. 801 CHOPHOUSE (Inspection Date: 06/03/2025) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain A QUATERNARY AMMONIA, AN ANTIMICROBIAL FRUIT AND VEGETABLE TREATMENT, AND A LAST RINSE SANITIZER test kit.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER INSTALLED ON MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED INFORMATION OF APPROVED SPLITTER WITH CFM. CFM WILL NEED TO INSTALL AN APPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.
